heading: Purpose
lead: The purpose of this chapter is to protect against the risks to life, property, and the environment that are inherent in the transportation of hazardous material in intrastate, interstate, and foreign commerce.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 510149 App.:1801.Jan. 3, 1975, Pub. L. 93–633, § 102, 88 Stat. 2156. The words “It is declared to be the policy of Congress”, “the Nation”, and “which are” are omitted as surplus.

Amendments2005—Pub. L. 109–59 substituted “The purpose of this chapter is to protect against the risks to life, property, and the environment that are inherent in the transportation of hazardous material in intrastate, interstate, and foreign commerce” for “The purpose of this chapter is to provide adequate protection against the risks to life and property inherent in the transportation of hazardous material in commerce by improving the regulatory and enforcement authority of the Secretary of Transportation”.

L. 114–94, div.
